        public void onBreakBlockWithItem(org.bukkit.event.block.BlockBreakEvent event)
        Description copied from class: BaseSTBItem
        Called when a block is broken while holding an STB item. If the block being broken is an STB block, this event handler will be called before the event handler for the block being broken.
